title: RBI Penalty Order on TransUnion CIBIL Limited for Non-Compliance with Credit Information Compensation Framework
description: <cite index="18-7,18-8">RBI imposed a monetary penalty of ₹26,82,800 on TransUnion CIBIL Limited for non-compliance with provisions on Framework for compensation to customers for delayed updation/rectification of credit information, as the company failed to credit the compensation amount to eligible complainants within the prescribed period</cite>.
